environment.virtualizer: QEMU 11.1.3 with local WHPX fixes; four socket-connected guests

method.cpu_definition: first eight /proc/stat ticks; user+nice+system+irq+softirq divided by total, including idle/iowait/steal in denominator
method.measurement_window: resident before/after marks; TCP warmup/run, a two-second tail, and any late sender completion; management overhead remains included
method.attribution_limits: per-process deltas for matching PID/starttime only; exited/new/execing tasks and asynchronous reads prevent exact component attribution
method.resident_cpu_time: sampling loop and control handling; startup/imports and final JSON encoding excluded
method.host_cpu: GetSystemTimes across 32 logical CPUs; GetProcessTimes per QEMU/switch normalized to one logical CPU, sampled at nominal 250 ms
method.rate_quality: sender within 1%, entry delivery within 1%, no switch drops; arrival counter separately checks all offered packets
method.arrival_timing: switch monotonic timestamps before forwarding; 100-ms bins; first-to-last rate excludes final sender pacing sleep

cohorts.pilot: three clean collection controls, then original/observed sender at 10k; early broad UDP observer, no background packets within trial windows
cohorts.main: 12 requested-25k diagnostics using exact observer and new SSH workload launches; three repeats, rotated/reversed order
cohorts.switchcheck: two requested-25k diagnostics after batching selector updates and buffer compaction; still new SSH workload launches
cohorts.jobprobe: one 10k functional trial launching jobs through the existing resident process
cohorts.resident25: two requested-25k diagnostics using persistent launches; rate still not reached
cohorts.persistent: 12 matched 15k trials, persistent workload launches, three repeats per policy; optional new SSH tail snapshot is the deliberate intervention

method.public_data: aggregates, worst-window evidence, arrival bins and examples; full CPU/process/host/burst traces retained locally
